title: Radius: sharp to round
summary: Defines the radius engine: radius.roundness (0-100) and radius.pill drive role-based --uis-r-* corner variables, five named presets, and rules for nesting, overrides and textareas.
notes: No frontmatter or path convention. Content is a token contract (role/variable/value tables, preset table, config API, must-follow rules), so SPEC over DOC. Filename hash suffix is a placeholder: classifier had no shell to compute SHA-256 of the source path; filename is unique in docs/ so no collision expected.
